metadata.title: SAGA: A Fast Incremental Gradient Method With Support for Non-Strongly Convex Composite Objectives

nodes.name: Composite finite-sum minimisation
nodes.statement: Minimise $F(x) = f(x) + h(x)$ where $f(x) = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} f_i(x)$, each $f_i$ is convex with $L$-Lipschitz gradient (optionally $\mu$-strongly convex), and $h$ is convex possibly non-differentiable with a tractable proximal operator.
nodes.statement_clean: Minimise the sum of $n$ smooth convex losses plus a (proximable) regulariser.

nodes.name: Proximal operator
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{prox}^{h}_{\stepsize}(y) := \arg\min_{x \in \mathbb{R}^d} \{ h(x) + \frac{1}{2\stepsize}\|x-y\|^2 \}$.

nodes.name: Lyapunov function $T$
nodes.statement: $T^k := \frac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i(\phi_i^k) - f(x^*) - \frac{1}{n}\sum_i \langle f_i'(x^*), \phi_i^k - x^* \rangle + c\|x^k - x^*\|^2$.
nodes.statement_clean: Lyapunov potential combining a Bregman-style gradient-table term with the squared distance to the optimum.

nodes.name: Variance-reduced estimator $\theta_\alpha$
nodes.statement: Given correlated random variables $X, Y$ with $\mathbb{E}Y$ computable, define $\theta_\alpha := \alpha(X-Y) + \mathbb{E}Y$ for $\alpha \in [0,1]$, so $\mathbb{E}\theta_\alpha = \alpha\,\mathbb{E}X + (1-\alpha)\,\mathbb{E}Y$.
nodes.statement_clean: Generalised control-variate estimator interpolating between $\mathbb{E}Y$ ($\alpha=0$) and an unbiased estimate of $\mathbb{E}X$ ($\alpha=1$).

nodes.name: SAGA
nodes.statement: Incremental gradient method with a stored gradient table: at each step, sample $j$ uniformly, replace $f_j'(\phi_j^k)$ in the table, and take a proximal step $x^{k+1} = \mathrm{prox}^h_\stepsize(w^{k+1})$.
nodes.statement_clean: Variance-reduced stochastic gradient method with a stored gradient table and a proximal step on the regulariser.
nodes.pseudocode: Repeat: (1) Pick $j$ uniformly at random; (2) set $\phi_j^{k+1} = x^k$, store $f_j'(\phi_j^{k+1})$ replacing the previous entry; (3) compute $w^{k+1} = x^k - \stepsize[f_j'(\phi_j^{k+1}) - f_j'(\phi_j^k) + \frac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i'(\phi_i^k)]$ and $x^{k+1} = \mathrm{prox}^h_\stepsize(w^{k+1})$.

nodes.name: SAGA: equivalent reformulation (non-composite, $u$-form)
nodes.statement: Equivalent rewriting of SAGA in the non-composite case using $u^k$ with $u^0 := x^0 + \stepsize \sum_i f_i'(x^0)$, exposing the link to Finito/MISO$\mu$.
nodes.pseudocode: (1) $x^k = u^k - \stepsize \sum_i f_i'(\phi_i^k)$; (2) $u^{k+1} = u^k + \frac{1}{n}(x^k - u^k)$; (3) pick $j$ uniformly; (4) $\phi_j^{k+1} = x^k$ and store $f_j'(\phi_j^{k+1})$.

nodes.name: SDCA in the primal
nodes.statement: Primal reformulation of SDCA obtained via the Moreau decomposition $\mathrm{prox}^{f^*}(v) = v - \mathrm{prox}^{f}(v)$, which eliminates explicit dual variables.
nodes.pseudocode: (1) Pick $j$ uniformly; (2) compute $\phi_j^{k+1} = \mathrm{prox}^{f_j}_{\stepsize}(z)$ where $z = -\stepsize \sum_{i\neq j} f_i'(\phi_i^k)$; (3) store $f_j'(\phi_j^{k+1}) = (z - \phi_j^{k+1})/\stepsize$ in the table; return $x^k = -\stepsize \sum_i f_i'(\phi_i^k)$.

nodes.name: SDCA/Finito midpoint
nodes.statement: Variant obtained by moving the strong-convexity bound inside each $f_i$: the SDCA update becomes $\phi_j^{k+1} = \mathrm{prox}^{f_j}_{(\mu(n-1))^{-1}}(z)$ with $z = \frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{i\neq j}\phi_i^k - \frac{1}{\mu(n-1)}\sum_{i\neq j} f_i'(\phi_i^k)$, yielding a method midway between Finito and SDCA with no tunable parameters.

nodes.name: SAG (Stochastic Average Gradient)
nodes.statement: Biased variance-reduced stochastic gradient method with the update $x^{k+1} = x^k - \stepsize[\frac{1}{n}(f_j'(x^k) - f_j'(\phi_j^k)) + \frac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i'(\phi_i^k)]$ (i.e. $\alpha = 1/n$ in the variance-reduction view).

nodes.name: SVRG (Stochastic Variance Reduced Gradient)
nodes.statement: Unbiased variance-reduced method with update $x^{k+1} = x^k - \stepsize[f_j'(x^k) - f_j'(\tilde{x}) + \frac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i'(\tilde{x})]$, where $\tilde{x}$ is refreshed only at the start of each outer loop.

nodes.name: Finito / MISO$\mu$
nodes.statement: Update $x^{k+1} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_i \phi_i^k - \stepsize \sum_i f_i'(\phi_i^k)$ with step $\stepsize \sim 1/(\mu n)$.

nodes.name: SDCA (Stochastic Dual Coordinate Ascent)
nodes.statement: Block coordinate ascent on the dual of an $\ell_2$-regularised empirical risk; per step, $\alpha_j^{k+1} = \alpha_j^k + \arg\max_{\Delta \alpha_j} \{ -f_j^*(-\alpha_j^k - \Delta\alpha_j) - \frac{\mu n}{2}\|x^k + \frac{1}{\mu n}\Delta\alpha_j\|^2 \}$.

nodes.name: SAGA main update for $w^{k+1}$
nodes.statement: $w^{k+1} = x^k - \stepsize\!\left[ f_j'(\phi_j^{k+1}) - f_j'(\phi_j^k) + \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n f_i'(\phi_i^k) \right]$.

nodes.name: SAG vs SAGA vs SVRG side-by-side updates
nodes.statement: $x^{k+1} = x^k - \stepsize[\tfrac{1}{n}(f_j'(x^k)-f_j'(\phi_j^k)) + \tfrac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i'(\phi_i^k)]$ (SAG); $x^{k+1} = x^k - \stepsize[f_j'(x^k)-f_j'(\phi_j^k) + \tfrac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i'(\phi_i^k)]$ (SAGA); $x^{k+1} = x^k - \stepsize[f_j'(x^k)-f_j'(\tilde{x}) + \tfrac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i'(\tilde{x})]$ (SVRG).

nodes.name: Finito/MISO$\mu$ update
nodes.statement: $x^{k+1} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_i \phi_i^k - \stepsize \sum_{i=1}^n f_i'(\phi_i^k)$.

nodes.name: Moreau decomposition
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{prox}^{f^*}(v) = v - \mathrm{prox}^{f}(v)$.

nodes.name: Lemma 1 (inner-product bound)
nodes.statement: $\langle f'(x), x^* - x \rangle \leq \frac{L-\mu}{L}[f(x^*)-f(x)] - \frac{\mu}{2}\|x^*-x\|^2 - \frac{1}{2Ln}\sum_i \|f_i'(x^*)-f_i'(x)\|^2 - \frac{\mu}{L}\langle f'(x^*), x-x^* \rangle$.

nodes.name: Lemma 2 (gradient-difference bound at stored points)
nodes.statement: $\frac{1}{n}\sum_i \|f_i'(\phi_i)-f_i'(x^*)\|^2 \leq 2L[\frac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i(\phi_i) - f(x^*) - \frac{1}{n}\sum_i \langle f_i'(x^*), \phi_i - x^*\rangle]$.
assumptions: Each $f_i$ has $L$-Lipschitz gradient and is convex

nodes.name: Lemma 3 ($w$-change bound)
nodes.statement: $\mathbb{E}\|w^{k+1}-x^k-\stepsize f'(x^*)\|^2 \leq \stepsize^2(1+\beta^{-1})\mathbb{E}\|f_j'(\phi_j^k)-f_j'(x^*)\|^2 + \stepsize^2(1+\beta)\mathbb{E}\|f_j'(x^k)-f_j'(x^*)\|^2 - \stepsize^2 \beta\|f'(x^k)-f'(x^*)\|^2$.
assumptions: $w^{k+1}$ as in the SAGA update (Eq. EP259.1)

nodes.name: Lemma A1 (strong-convexity lower bound)
nodes.statement: $f(x) \geq f(y) + \langle f'(y), x-y\rangle + \frac{1}{2(L-\mu)}\|f'(x)-f'(y)\|^2 + \frac{\mu L}{2(L-\mu)}\|y-x\|^2 + \frac{\mu}{L-\mu}\langle f'(x)-f'(y), y-x\rangle$.

nodes.name: Theorem 1 (Lyapunov contraction in the strongly convex case)
nodes.statement: With $\stepsize = \frac{1}{2(\mu n + L)}$, $c = \frac{1}{2\stepsize(1-\stepsize\mu)n}$ and $\kappa = \frac{1}{\stepsize\mu}$, the SAGA Lyapunov function satisfies $\mathbb{E}[T^{k+1}] \leq (1 - 1/\kappa) T^k$.
assumptions: $h$ is convex with tractable proximal operator

nodes.name: Corollary 1 (linear convergence in iterate distance)
nodes.statement: $\mathbb{E}\|x^k-x^*\|^2 \leq (1 - \frac{\mu}{2(\mu n + L)})^k \big[\|x^0-x^*\|^2 + \frac{n}{\mu n + L}[f(x^0) - \langle f'(x^*), x^0 - x^*\rangle - f(x^*)]\big]$.

nodes.name: Theorem 2 (sublinear $O(n/k)$ rate, non-strongly convex case)
nodes.statement: When each $f_i$ is convex (no strong convexity) and $\stepsize = 1/(3L)$: $\mathbb{E}[F(\bar{x}^k)]-F(x^*) \leq \frac{4n}{k}\big[\frac{2L}{n}\|x^0-x^*\|^2 + f(x^0) - \langle f'(x^*), x^0-x^*\rangle - f(x^*)\big]$, where $\bar{x}^k = \frac{1}{k}\sum_{t=1}^k x^t$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 1
nodes.statement: Bound the conditional change in each term of the Lyapunov function $T^k$, applying non-expansiveness of the prox, Lemma LP259.3 for the $w$-change term, and Lemmas LP259.1, LP259.2 to absorb the cross terms; choose $\beta = (2\mu n+L)/L$ so that all `bracket' coefficients are non-positive.

nodes.name: Expand $f$- and inner-product terms of $T^{k+1}$
nodes.statement: $\mathbb{E}[\frac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i(\phi_i^{k+1})] = \frac{1}{n}f(x^k) + (1-\frac{1}{n})\frac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i(\phi_i^k)$, and similarly $\mathbb{E}[-\frac{1}{n}\sum_i \langle f_i'(x^*), \phi_i^{k+1}-x^*\rangle] = -\frac{1}{n}\langle f'(x^*), x^k-x^*\rangle - (1-\frac{1}{n})\frac{1}{n}\sum_i \langle f_i'(x^*), \phi_i^k-x^*\rangle$.

nodes.name: Apply non-expansiveness of prox
nodes.statement: $c\|x^{k+1}-x^*\|^2 = c\|\mathrm{prox}_\stepsize(w^{k+1}) - \mathrm{prox}_\stepsize(x^* - \stepsize f'(x^*))\|^2 \leq c\|w^{k+1} - x^* + \stepsize f'(x^*)\|^2$ (uses optimality of $x^*$).

nodes.name: Expand quadratic and use $\mathbb{E}[w^{k+1}] = x^k - \stepsize f'(x^k)$
nodes.statement: Splitting $w^{k+1}-x^*+\stepsize f'(x^*) = (x^k-x^*) + (w^{k+1}-x^k+\stepsize f'(x^*))$ and using $\mathbb{E}[w^{k+1}-x^k] = -\stepsize f'(x^k)$ to simplify the cross term, then bounding the residual via Lemma LP259.3.

nodes.name: Apply Lemma 1 and Lemma 2 to absorb cross terms
nodes.statement: Bound $-2c\stepsize\langle f'(x^k), x^k-x^*\rangle$ via Lemma LP259.1 and $\mathbb{E}\|f_j'(\phi_j^k)-f_j'(x^*)\|^2$ via Lemma LP259.2, then collect terms.

nodes.name: Choose constants so brackets are non-positive
nodes.statement: Together with $-\|f'(x^k)-f'(x^*)\|^2 \leq -2\mu[f(x^k)-f(x^*)-\langle f'(x^*), x^k-x^*\rangle]$, the choices $\stepsize=1/(2(\mu n+L))$, $c = 1/(2\stepsize(1-\stepsize\mu)n)$, $\kappa = 1/(\stepsize\mu)$, $\beta = (2\mu n + L)/L$ make every round-bracketed coefficient non-positive, leaving $\mathbb{E}[T^{k+1}] - T^k \leq -T^k/\kappa$.

nodes.name: Adaptivity-to-strong-convexity addendum
nodes.statement: With $\stepsize = 1/(3L)$, the same $c$, $\beta = 2$ and $1/\kappa = \min\{1/(4n), \mu/(3L)\}$ also give non-positive coefficients, so the algorithm linearly converges adaptively whenever $\mu > 0$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 2 (non-strongly convex case)
nodes.statement: Augment the Lyapunov function with an extra $\alpha\|x^k-x^*\|^2$ term, bound this term using a prox-SVRG inequality with $\Delta = -\frac{1}{\stepsize}(w^{k+1}-x^k) - f'(x^k)$, then telescope to obtain the $4n/k$ rate.

nodes.name: Augmented Lyapunov function
nodes.statement: Add $\alpha\|x^k-x^*\|^2$ to the Lyapunov function used in Theorem 1 and treat it differently from the $c\|x^k-x^*\|^2$ term.

nodes.name: Use prox-SVRG inequality on $\alpha$-term
nodes.statement: Setting $\Delta = -\frac{1}{\stepsize}(w^{k+1}-x^k)-f'(x^k)$, apply the prox-SVRG bound $\alpha\mathbb{E}\|x^{k+1}-x^*\|^2 \leq \alpha\|x^k-x^*\|^2 - 2\alpha\stepsize\mathbb{E}[F(x^{k+1})-F(x^*)] + 2\alpha\stepsize^2\mathbb{E}\|\Delta\|^2$ (uses only $\mathbb{E}[\Delta]=0$).

nodes.name: Bound $\mathbb{E}\|\Delta\|^2$
nodes.statement: A modification of the proof of Lemma LP259.3 yields $\mathbb{E}\|\Delta\|^2 \leq (1+\beta^{-1})\mathbb{E}\|f_j'(\phi_j^k)-f_j'(x^*)\|^2 + (1+\beta)\mathbb{E}\|f_j'(x^k)-f_j'(x^*)\|^2$.

nodes.name: Tune constants $\beta=1$, $c=3L/(2n)$, $\alpha=3L/(8n)$
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma LP259.2 to the $\phi$-term and combine with the Theorem 1 bound (with $\mu=0$). The choices $\stepsize=1/(3L)$, $\beta=1$, $c=3L/(2n)$, $\alpha=3L/(8n)$ zero out all round-bracketed coefficients and yield $\mathbb{E}[T^{k+1}]-T^k \leq -\frac{1}{4n}\mathbb{E}[F(x^{k+1})-F(x^*)]$.

nodes.name: Telescope and apply convexity
nodes.statement: Sum over $k$ to telescope $T$, drop $-\mathbb{E}[T^k] \leq 0$, then push the average inside $F$ by convexity to get $\mathbb{E}[F(\bar{x}^k)-F(x^*)] \leq \frac{4n}{k}T^0$, with $T^0 \leq (c+\alpha)\|x^0-x^*\|^2 + \dots \leq \frac{2L}{n}\|x^0-x^*\|^2 + \dots$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma A1 (strong-convexity lower bound)
nodes.statement: Define $g(x) = f(x) - \frac{\mu}{2}\|x\|^2$, which has $(L-\mu)$-Lipschitz gradient; apply the standard convex inequality $g(x) \geq g(y) + \langle g'(y), x-y\rangle + \frac{1}{2(L-\mu)}\|g'(x)-g'(y)\|^2$ and substitute back.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 1 (corollary of Lemma A1)
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma LP259.4 with $y = x^*$, average over the $f_i$ functions.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 2
nodes.statement: Apply $f(y) \geq f(x) + \langle f'(x), y-x\rangle + \frac{1}{2L}\|f'(x)-f'(y)\|^2$ with $y=\phi_i$, $x=x^*$, for each $f_i$, and sum over $i$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma 3 ($w$-change)
nodes.statement: Mirror the SVRG variance argument with the tighter inequality $\|x+y\|^2 \leq (1+\beta^{-1})\|x\|^2 + (1+\beta)\|y\|^2$ and the variance decomposition $\mathbb{E}\|X-\mathbb{E}X\|^2 = \mathbb{E}\|X\|^2 - \|\mathbb{E}X\|^2$ (used three times).

nodes.name: SAGA as the variance-reduction midpoint between SAG and SVRG
nodes.statement: In the variance-reduction template $\theta_\alpha = \alpha(X-Y)+\mathbb{E}Y$ with $X = f_j'(x^k)$, $Y = f_j'(\phi_j^k)$: SAG corresponds to $\alpha=1/n$ (biased), SAGA to $\alpha=1$ (unbiased) with table updated per step, SVRG to $\alpha=1$ with $Y = f_j'(\tilde{x})$ updated only between outer loops.

nodes.name: Adaptivity to strong convexity
nodes.statement: When the step size $\stepsize = 1/(3L)$ is used, SAGA automatically adapts to any inherent strong convexity $\mu > 0$, achieving rate $(1 - \min\{1/(4n), \mu/(3L)\})^k$ without retuning.

nodes.name: Storage trick for linear predictors
nodes.statement: When each $f_i$ is a function of $X_i^T x$ (logistic regression, least squares), storing one scalar per $i$ suffices for the gradient table, matching SDCA's memory cost; for $p$-class problems, $p-1$ scalars per $i$.

nodes.name: Just-in-time updating for sparse gradients
nodes.statement: For sparse derivatives, the dense $u$ or $x$ updates can be replaced by lazy (just-in-time) updates so that each iteration touches only the active coordinates, mirroring the standard SAG trick.

nodes.name: Explicit-quadratic-regulariser variant
nodes.statement: When strong convexity is induced by an explicit quadratic regulariser, use the modified update $x^{k+1} = (1-\stepsize\mu)x^k - \stepsize[f_j'(x^k)-f_j'(\phi_j^k)+\frac{1}{n}\sum_i f_i'(\phi_i^k)]$, with a separate scaling constant $\beta^k$ in the sparse implementation.

nodes.name: Empirical comparison on MNIST, COVTYPE, IJCNN1, MILLIONSONG
nodes.statement: Binary logistic classifier on MNIST/COVTYPE/IJCNN1 and least-squares on MILLIONSONG, with both $\ell_2$ and $\ell_1$ regularisation. SAGA performs comparably to non-permuted Finito and SDCA; Finito (perm) is best per epoch but most expensive per step; SVRG does roughly $2\times$ the gradient evaluations per epoch.

nodes.name: Sparse least-squares / ridge regression Cython implementation
nodes.statement: Cython code for SAGA on sparse least-squares with $\ell_2$ regularisation, illustrating just-in-time updating, the $\beta^k$ scaling trick, and the geometric-series table $\mathrm{lag\_scaling}$.
